note:
The chunk tier with BOTH of its streamed operands on the slab ring, two slots deep, and its expectation on the reduced-accumulate cell. Each of the three is a distinct emission the corpus had no live coverage of: the score's key arrives through `_a_smem` beside the value's `_b_smem` and drains N-major with the plain ldmatrix, every slab read rides the skeleton's own ring slot rather than a literal 0, and the expectation's mma targets a packed f16 fragment whose `FragmentPromote` folds it into the f32 carrier once per chunk. The query is hoisted out of the chunk loop and read once per score-K step, which is what the straight-line steps here exist to hold.

Together they are the article's FlashAttention-2 kernel: on an RTX 5090 at the article's own (1, 8, 4096, 64) shape the same spelling measures 1.25x eager, against 0.55x before any of them.

attrs.body:
let f32 v0 = 0.125
for a0 in 0..4:
    for a1 in 0..256:
        for a2 in 0..256:
            for a3 in 0..64:
                in0 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a3]
                in1 = load x1[0, a0, a2, a3]
                f32 v1 = multiply(in0, in1)
                acc1 <- add(acc1, v1) over a3
            v2 = multiply(acc1, v0)
            acc0 <- maximum(acc0, v2) over a2
        for a2 in 0..256:
            for a5 in 0..64:
                in2 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a5]
                in3 = load x1[0, a0, a2, a5]
                f32 v3 = multiply(in2, in3)
                acc3 <- add(acc3, v3) over a5
            v4 = multiply(acc3, v0)
            v5 = subtract(v4, acc0)
            v6 = exp(v5)
            acc2 <- add(acc2, v6) over a2
        for a6 in 0..64:
            for a7 in 0..256:
                for a8 in 0..64:
                    in4 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a8]
                    in5 = load x1[0, a0, a7, a8]
                    f32 v7 = multiply(in4, in5)
                    acc5 <- add(acc5, v7) over a8
                v8 = multiply(acc5, v0)
                v9 = subtract(v8, acc0)
                v10 = exp(v9)
                v11 = divide(v10, acc2)
                in6 = load x2[0, a0, a7, a6]
                v12 = multiply(in6, v11)
                acc4 <- add(acc4, v12) over a7
            scaled_dot_product_attention[0, a0, a1, a6] = acc4
